_meta.note: Win rates come from the lolalytics Jax counters page (Emerald+, patch 26.19; the site labels it 16.19), pulled 2026-09-28. The op.gg Emerald+ 26.19 figure is given in winRateSource as a cross-check. The current meta has two builds. AD: Plated Steelcaps/Ionian Boots of Lucidity -> Trinity Force -> Sundered Sky -> Sterak's Gage/Death's Dance. Hybrid: Dusk and Dawn -> Riftmaker/Zhonya's Hourglass. Standard runes are Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Conditioning, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). The most popular alternative on op.gg is Lethal Tempo (Triumph, Legend: Alacrity, Last Stand + Bone Plating, Unflinching). Starters that exist in 26.19: Doran's Blade, Doran's Shield, Doran's Helm, and Doran's Bow (added 26.09). Per-matchup rune and item stats on lolalytics come from small samples, so read them as hints only.

Tryndamere.name: Tryndamere
Tryndamere.summary: This is an even skill matchup. Tryndamere's damage is almost all basic attacks, so a well-timed Counter Strike wins most trades. You lose if you waste E or fight into Undying Rage without an answer.
Tryndamere.runes: Grasp of the Undying (standard). Lethal Tempo is fine if you want to win extended duels.
Tryndamere.summoners: Flash + Exhaust. Exhaust is the most-picked option on lolalytics and cuts his crit damage during Undying Rage.
Tryndamere.start: Doran's Blade + Health Potion (Doran's Bow is a common aggressive alternative)
Tryndamere.buildNotes: Rush Plated Steelcaps. Standard Trinity Force -> Sundered Sky. Death's Dance is strong into his burst. If he gets fed on crit, Randuin's Omen is a valid defensive slot.
Tryndamere.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2 for fast trades. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Keep E for when he commits with Spinning Slash or starts auto-attacking. Stun him, then trade autos with W.
Don't let him stack Fury for free on the wave. Trade when his Fury bar is low, because his crits need Fury.
lvl4_5: When he uses Mocking Shout, back off or E. His armor is shredded for that window, but so is your damage output. Punish him after it ends.
Short trades are Leap Strike -> Counter Strike -> W auto -> walk out. Don't stay in long extended fights before level 6.
post6: Undying Rage lasts about 5s. Save Counter Strike and Exhaust for after he casts it, or just walk away/Leap Strike to a ward and wait it out.
Your Grandmaster's Might resists and his inability to die make the first 5s pointless. Kite with Q to a minion, then re-engage once R ends.
midgame: Both of you want to split push. Once you have Trinity Force + Sundered Sky, you win the side lane if you keep E for his Undying Rage.
He has no CC except Mocking Shout's slow, so you can hold him in side lane and let your team take objectives.
lategame: Match his split. In a teamfight, E + R-stun him when he dives your carry and keep him occupied until Undying Rage expires.

threats: Undying Rage (R): 5s of not dying. Don't burn E or Exhaust before he casts it.
Spinning Slash (E) resets on crits, so a high-crit Tryndamere can chain it to escape or chase.
Bloodlust (Q) heal at full Fury. Ignite or Executioner's Calling reduces it if he stalls.
killWindows: Right after his Undying Rage ends with no Spinning Slash up.
When he has used Bloodlust to heal and is at low Fury, because his crits and damage drop.
avoid: Casting Counter Strike before he starts attacking. He simply waits it out.
All-ins at level 6+ when you have no E or Exhaust for his R.

Urgot.name: Urgot
Urgot.summary: This is roughly even. Urgot wins extended fights where he stays at range and gets leg procs. You win short trades, especially when you jump him after Disdain is on cooldown.
Urgot.runes: Grasp of the Undying, or Press the Attack (the highest-WR keystone on lolalytics, small sample)
Urgot.summoners: Flash + Teleport (most-picked on lolalytics), or Flash + Ignite to play aggressive
Urgot.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (best-WR start on lolalytics), or Doran's Shield
Urgot.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps are the most-picked boots. Blade of The Ruined King and Zhonya's Hourglass both show high win rates here. Zhonya's also counters Fear Beyond Death.
Urgot.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Don't stand in Purge's cone. Stay out of range until he commits, then Leap Strike into him when he uses Corrosive Charge or Disdain on the wave.
Low-rank Purge has a real cooldown before he maxes it. Trade when it's down.
lvl4_5: His legs (Echoing Flames) each have a cooldown. Short trades with Q-E-W and backing out keep him from cycling all six legs.
If he flips you with Disdain, E immediately. You take the stun and return trade instead of eating free damage.
post6: Fear Beyond Death executes you below 25% HP and pulls you in. Leave the fight early. Don't trade near 25-35% HP.
Your R resists plus an E-stun let you win all-ins when you start above 50% HP and his E is down.
midgame: He is slow and immobile. Flank or split and pull him into you away from his team.
Once you have 2 items, you out-duel him in side lane. Keep your HP high when you engage so his R can't execute.
lategame: In teamfights, dive him only after his R has been used on someone else. Otherwise play for backline access.

threats: Fear Beyond Death (R): execute threshold at 25% HP. Respect it from level 6.
Disdain (E): shield plus flip/stun onto his legs. Dodge it or answer with E.
Purge (W) at rank 5 becomes a permanent toggle and shreds you in melee range.
killWindows: After he uses Disdain (E) on a minion or misses it: no escape, jump with Leap Strike.
Pre-6 when Purge is on cooldown and he's below 60%.
avoid: Long fights in his leg range while Purge is up.
Fighting at around 30% HP from level 6.

Volibear.name: Volibear
Volibear.summary: Favorable for you. Most of Volibear's damage comes from autos and his Thundering Smash attack, so Counter Strike blanks him. You outscale him from 2 items onward.
Volibear.runes: Press the Attack (most-picked and best-WR on lolalytics) or Grasp of the Undying
Volibear.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion (best-WR on lolalytics) or Doran's Blade
Volibear.buildNotes: Blade of The Ruined King performs very well against his HP stacking. Riftmaker also works. Gluttonous Greaves or Plated Steelcaps.
Volibear.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: When he runs at you with Thundering Smash (Q), activate Counter Strike. It dodges the empowered attack and his autos, then stun him back.
Frenzied Maul (W) can't be dodged. Walk away when he has one W mark on you, because the second bite heals him a lot.
lvl4_5: Stand outside Sky Splitter's (E) circle when the lightning lands, or you take damage and he gets a shield.
Trade into him when Q is on cooldown. He has little else to catch you with.
post6: Stormbringer (R) disables towers. Don't let him dive you under tower at low HP. Instead fight back with E + R.
Your ultimate's resists plus E blanking his autos win fair all-ins.
midgame: With Blade of The Ruined King + Trinity Force you out-duel him easily. Split push and force him to answer.
lategame: Stay away from his R tower-disable dives in teamfights. Peel your carries with E stun, or dive his backline.

threats: Thundering Smash (Q) stun plus W double bite heals him and gives him a big burst early.
Stormbringer (R) tower disable enables dives and ganks.
killWindows: After he uses Q (it has a long cooldown early). Jump in with Leap Strike + E.
Level 6 all-in when he doesn't have Q up.
avoid: Casting E before he actually commits Q, because he walks away and waits.

Warwick.name: Warwick
Warwick.summary: Favorable for you. Warwick relies on autos and sustain. Counter Strike blanks his autos, and Ignite cuts his low-HP healing. You win both lane and side lane.
Warwick.runes: Grasp of the Undying or Press the Attack
Warwick.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite cuts Eternal Hunger and Jaws of the Beast healing)
Warwick.buildNotes: Standard Trinity Force -> Sundered Sky. Get Executioner's Calling early if his healing keeps him alive.
Warwick.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Trade short when he tries to Jaws of the Beast (Q). E + stun, then W-auto out.
Don't chase him at low HP. Eternal Hunger heals him more when he's low. Finish him with Ignite instead.
lvl4_5: Primal Howl (E) gives him damage reduction and then fears. Don't jump in the moment he casts it. Wait it out or walk back.
When his Blood Hunt (W) is active on you at low HP, respect his chase speed.
post6: Infinite Duress (R) suppresses you. Stay out of max range when possible. Your E can still stun him right after his R ends.
You win all-ins from even HP with R resists plus E.
midgame: Split and duel him. With 2 items you win clearly. Watch for his R flank in skirmishes.
lategame: Keep him off your carry with E stun after his R. Otherwise split push.

threats: Infinite Duress (R) suppression, especially with jungle follow-up.
Low-HP healing from Eternal Hunger and Q.
killWindows: After Primal Howl ends and it's on cooldown.
When he's below 40%: Ignite + Leap Strike + E to shut off his healing.
avoid: Extended fights without Ignite when he's low and healing.
Leap Striking into an active Primal Howl.

MonkeyKing.name: Wukong
MonkeyKing.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, low sample 247 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 50.99)
MonkeyKing.summary: Slightly favorable. Wukong's short trades use Crushing Blow and autos, which Counter Strike dodges. The main danger is getting baited onto his clone.
MonkeyKing.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps into his physical damage. Standard Trinity Force -> Sundered Sky, with Death's Dance later.
MonkeyKing.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: He trades with Nimbus Strike (E) -> auto -> Crushing Blow (Q). Cast Counter Strike when he dashes in to dodge the Q attack and stun him.
lvl4_5: When he casts Warrior Trickster (W), he goes invisible and leaves a clone. Don't Leap Strike or E on the clone. Wait for his real position.
Stone Skin gives him extra armor in extended fights, so keep trades short.
post6: Cyclone (R) can be recast for two knockups. Keep E for after the knockups or walk out of the spin.
When he uses R to engage, stun him with E and turn with your R.
midgame: You outscale him in 1v1s. Split push and hold him in side lane.
lategame: His R engage is his value. Peel or dive his backline after it's used.

threats: Warrior Trickster (W) clone baiting your Q/E.
killWindows: After he uses W and E (both on cooldown), he has no escape.
Level 6 all-in once R has been used.
avoid: Casting E before he commits with E/Q.

Yasuo.name: Yasuo
Yasuo.summary: Favorable for you. Most of Yasuo's damage is crit autos, which Counter Strike dodges. Wind Wall doesn't stop Leap Strike. Pop his passive shield before you commit.
Yasuo.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
Yasuo.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion or Doran's Blade
Yasuo.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps. Standard AD or hybrid (Dusk and Dawn -> Zhonya's Hourglass) both do well. Death's Dance helps later.
Yasuo.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Poke his Way of the Wanderer shield with an auto or W first. Then commit Leap Strike + Counter Strike.
He wants to Sweeping Blade (E) through the wave to you. Stand so he has to dash toward you, then E to stun.
lvl4_5: Watch his Steel Tempest stacks. When Q3 (tornado) is ready, stay out of line or keep E for after the knockup.
Leap Strike can follow his E dashes to minions. Use it to finish trades.
post6: Last Breath needs a knockup. Deny his tornado and your all-in wins.
Your R resists plus E dodging his crits make him lose fair all-ins.
midgame: Once you have 2 items you out-duel him. Punish his split with side-lane pressure.
lategame: In teamfights, E + stun him the moment he dashes in for R.

threats: Q3 tornado knockup into Last Breath (R).
Way of the Wanderer passive shield absorbs your first trade.
killWindows: After his shield is popped and Q3 is used.
When he's out of E dash stacks near the wave.
avoid: Starting a trade into a full shield.
Walking into the tornado line when your E is down.

Yone.name: Yone
Yone.summary: Slightly favorable. Counter Strike blanks his crit autos. Spirit Unbound snaps him back to his body, so stand near where he'll return and punish.
Yone.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
Yone.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion or Doran's Blade
Yone.buildNotes: Standard Trinity Force -> Sundered Sky. Plated Steelcaps into his AD autos. His E and W deal mixed damage, so Steelcaps aren't mandatory.
Yone.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: He trades with Mortal Steel (Q) + autos. Cast E when he walks in to auto.
Spirit Cleave (W) gives him a shield. Trade after it's used.
lvl4_5: When he uses Spirit Unbound (E), don't chase his spirit. Walk to his body and hit him with Leap Strike + E when he snaps back.
Watch for Q3 (dash + knockup). Keep E for after the knockup or sidestep it.
post6: Fate Sealed (R) pulls and knocks up. Don't stand in a line with teammates.
You win all-ins when his E and Q3 are used.
midgame: Split push. You beat him in 1v1s at equal items. Keep E for his all-in.
lategame: Stun him with E the moment he dives your backline.

threats: Spirit Unbound (E) mark bursting you when he snaps back.
killWindows: When he snaps back from E. Hit him with Leap Strike + E stun at his body.
After Q3 and W are used.
avoid: Burning E before he commits Q3.

Yorick.name: Yorick
Yorick.summary: Slightly favorable for you, but the lane can be annoying. Clear his ghouls fast and keep Leap Strike to escape his Dark Procession cage. You out-split him mid to late.
Yorick.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Yorick.buildNotes: Ravenous Hydra is popular here because it clears ghouls and Maiden quickly. Standard Trinity Force works too.
Yorick.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Kill his Mist Walkers first. Their damage adds up. E dodges their autos.
lvl4_5: When he casts Dark Procession (W), Leap Strike to a minion or ward outside the cage.
Mourning Mist (E) marks you and speeds his ghouls toward you. Leave the area or kill the ghouls.
post6: Kill Maiden (from Eulogy of the Isles) first, or fight away from her. Your R active hits her and the ghouls.
You win all-ins when his W is used.
midgame: He wants to split. Match him and take trades when ghouls are down.
lategame: You out-duel him in side lane. Punish when Maiden is dead.

threats: Eulogy of the Isles (R) Maiden pushing towers.
killWindows: When W is on cooldown and ghouls are dead.
avoid: Fighting in the cage without Leap Strike.

Pantheon.name: Pantheon
Pantheon.summary: Hard lane. Pantheon bullies you at levels 1-5 with Shield Vault stun and empowered Comet Spear. Survive to level 6 and 2 items, then you outscale him.
Pantheon.runes: Conqueror (most-picked on lolalytics) or Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind/Bone Plating instead of Conditioning
Pantheon.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Pantheon.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps into his physical damage. Blade of The Ruined King performs well. Death's Dance can come earlier.
Pantheon.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Don't trade into his passive-empowered W. Farm safely.
Cast E when he Shield Vaults (W) to dodge his follow-up autos.
lvl4_5: Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from the front. Don't jump in while it's up. Leap Strike behind him to a minion or ward.
Stay out of his Comet Spear poke range.
post6: Grand Starfall (R) roams. Ping and push. When he's in lane, you win all-ins after his W is used.
midgame: You outscale him. Split push and hold him.
lategame: Dive him when his E is down.

threats: Shield Vault (W) stun into empowered Q/E.
killWindows: After his W is used.
After level 6 when his E is on cooldown.

Udyr.name: Udyr
Udyr.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, low sample 176 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 50.79)
Udyr.summary: Even. Udyr is strong early with Blazing Stampede stun and Wilding Claw. Counter Strike blanks his autos.
Udyr.buildNotes: Pick boots for the Udyr build you face: Plated Steelcaps into AD Udyr, Mercury's Treads into AP (Wingborne Storm-focused) Udyr.
Udyr.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: When he runs at you with Blazing Stampede (E), cast Counter Strike to dodge his autos.
lvl4_5: Iron Mantle (W) gives him a shield. Trade when it's down.
post6: You win all-ins when his E is on cooldown.
midgame: Split push. You out-duel him with 2 items.
lategame: Keep him off your carries with E.

killWindows: After his E is used.

Sion.name: Sion
Sion.summary: Even. Sion scales tanky, so you need Blade of The Ruined King or Sundered Sky to kill him. Dodge Decimating Smash, and cast E when he revives because Glory in Death's attacks are autos.
Sion.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
Sion.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Sion.buildNotes: Sundered Sky and Blade of The Ruined King perform well against his HP stacking.
Sion.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Walk out of Decimating Smash (Q) or Leap Strike to a minion away. A fully charged Q knocks you up.
lvl4_5: When Soul Furnace (W) shield pops, it deals damage. Don't stand next to him when it explodes.
Roar of the Slayer (E) slows and shreds your armor.
post6: Unstoppable Onslaught (R) knocks you up. Stay out of its path.
When he dies, cast E during Glory in Death to dodge his autos, or walk away.
midgame: Split push. He can't kill you. Take towers.
lategame: Beat him in side lane. Don't let him engage onto your team.

killWindows: After his Q is used and the W shield is down.

Malphite.name: Malphite
Malphite.summary: Hard matchup. Ground Slam's attack speed reduction counters your autos, and Malphite stacks armor. Build hybrid AP (Dusk and Dawn -> Riftmaker) to bypass his armor.
Malphite.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
Malphite.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Malphite.buildNotes: Dusk and Dawn -> Riftmaker -> Zhonya's Hourglass performs well against his armor.
Malphite.skillNotes: Take W at 1 (most-picked order on lolalytics), then E. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Farm. He pokes you with Seismic Shard (Q).
lvl4_5: Ground Slam (E) reduces your attack speed. Trade when it's down.
post6: Unstoppable Force (R) engages. Stay out of range.
midgame: Split push. Hybrid AP does well.
lategame: Don't group in his R range.

killWindows: When his E is on cooldown.
avoid: Building full AD into his armor.

Ornn.name: Ornn
Ornn.summary: Even. Ornn's Searing Charge knocks you up near walls or pillars. You outscale him in side lane.
Ornn.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
Ornn.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Ornn.buildNotes: Dusk and Dawn -> Riftmaker (lolalytics). Hybrid AP does well against his armor.
Ornn.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Farm. Don't fight near walls or his Volcanic Rupture (Q) pillar.
lvl4_5: Bellows Breath (W) makes you brittle, so his next hit knocks you up. Walk away.
post6: Call of the Forge God (R) engages. Stay out of range.
midgame: Split push. You beat him 1v1.
lategame: Don't group in his R range.

threats: Call of the Forge God (R) engage.
killWindows: When his E is on cooldown.

Shen.name: Shen
Shen.summary: Hard matchup. Spirit's Refuge blocks your autos, and Shadow Dash taunts you. Punish his R roams.
Shen.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
Shen.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Shen.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads (most-picked on lolalytics) -> Sundered Sky.
Shen.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Cast E when he uses Twilight Assault (Q) to dodge his empowered autos.
lvl4_5: Don't auto inside Spirit's Refuge (W). Wait for it to end.
post6: Stand United (R) leaves lane. Push and take plates.
midgame: Split push. Punish his R.
lategame: Beat him in side lane.

killWindows: After his W is used.

KSante.name: K'Sante
KSante.summary: Even. K'Sante's Path Maker charge and All Out ultimate are his big moments. Counter Strike blanks his autos.
KSante.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
KSante.start: Doran's Blade + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
KSante.buildNotes: Blade of The Ruined King performs well against his HP stacking. Iceborn Gauntlet also shows up on lolalytics.
KSante.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Farm. Cast E when he trades with autos.
lvl4_5: Path Maker (W) charges you. Walk out of its path.
post6: All Out (R) makes him squishy but deadly. Cast E and fight him when he's committed.
midgame: Split push. You beat him 1v1.
lategame: Keep E for his All Out.

killWindows: After his W is used.

Chogath.name: Cho'Gath
Chogath.summary: Even. Dodge Rupture, respect Feast's execute, and you outscale him in side lane.
Chogath.runes: Press the Attack (most-picked on lolalytics) or Grasp of the Undying
Chogath.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
Chogath.buildNotes: Blade of The Ruined King performs well against his HP stacking.
Chogath.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Dodge Rupture (Q). If he misses it, Leap Strike in.
lvl4_5: Feral Scream (W) silences you. Trade when it's down.
post6: Feast (R) deals true damage. Leave the fight when you're low.
midgame: Split push. You beat him 1v1.
lategame: Stay out of Feast range when low.

killWindows: When his Q is on cooldown.

DrMundo.name: Dr. Mundo
DrMundo.summary: Even. Dodge his cleavers, deny his passive canister, and use Ignite against Maximum Dosage.
DrMundo.runes: Grasp of the Undying (most-picked on lolalytics)
DrMundo.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (most-picked on lolalytics)
DrMundo.buildNotes: Blade of The Ruined King performs well against his HP. Executioner's Calling cuts his healing.
DrMundo.skillNotes: Take W at 1 (most-picked on lolalytics), then Q. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Stand behind minions to block Infected Bonesaw (Q).
lvl4_5: Walk over his passive canister to deny it.
post6: Maximum Dosage (R) heals him. Use Ignite.
midgame: Split push. You beat him 1v1.
lategame: Buy Executioner's Calling.

killWindows: When his R is on cooldown.

Poppy.name: Poppy
Poppy.summary: Hard matchup. Steadfast Presence stops your Leap Strike, and Heroic Charge pins you against walls. Bait her W before you commit.
Poppy.buildNotes: Blade of The Ruined King and Trinity Force perform well here.
Poppy.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Cast E when she autos to dodge her passive buckler.
lvl4_5: Don't Leap Strike while Steadfast Presence (W) is up. Bait it first.
post6: Keeper's Verdict (R) knocks you away. Stay out of range.
midgame: Split push. Bait her W.
lategame: Don't fight near walls.

killWindows: After her W is used.

Gragas.name: Gragas
Gragas.summary: Hard matchup. Gragas pokes you with Barrel Roll and disengages your Leap Strike with Explosive Cask. Punish him when Body Slam is on cooldown.
Gragas.runes: Press the Attack (most-picked on lolalytics) or Conqueror
Gragas.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads (most-picked on lolalytics). Hextech Gunblade shows a strong win rate on lolalytics (small sample).
Gragas.skillNotes: Start E. Take Q at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Cast E when he uses Drunken Rage (W) to dodge the empowered auto.
lvl4_5: Stand behind minions to block Body Slam (E).
post6: Explosive Cask (R) knocks you away. Wait for it before you commit.
midgame: Split push. Punish him when his E is down.
lategame: Don't commit into his R.

killWindows: After his E is used.

Maokai.name: Maokai
Maokai.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, low sample 122 games (not in op.gg list)
Maokai.summary: Favorable for you. Maokai can't kill you, and you outscale him in side lane. Watch for his Twisted Advance root.
Maokai.buildNotes: Standard Trinity Force -> Sundered Sky. Blade of The Ruined King against his HP.
Maokai.skillNotes: Start E. Take W at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Cast E when he autos to dodge his Sap Magic heal.
lvl4_5: Twisted Advance (W) roots you. Trade when it's down.
post6: Nature's Grasp (R) roots. Stay out of range.
midgame: Split push. You beat him 1v1.
lategame: Don't group in his R range.

killWindows: After his W is used.

Zaahen.name: Zaahen
Zaahen.summary: Favorable for you. Zaahen (released late 2025) builds stacks of Cultivation of War. Fight him when his stacks are low, and bait his revive.
Zaahen.runes: Grasp of the Undying (best-WR keystone on lolalytics)
Zaahen.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (best-WR on lolalytics)
Zaahen.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps -> Dusk and Dawn -> Zhonya's Hourglass (lolalytics). Executioner's Calling cuts his healing.
Zaahen.skillNotes: Start E. Take Q at 2. Max Q, then W.

lvl1_3: Cast E when he uses The Darkin Glaive (Q) to dodge the empowered attack.
lvl4_5: Dreaded Return (W) stuns at max range. Stay close or out of range.
post6: Grim Deliverance (R) gives him CC immunity. Wait it out.
midgame: Split push. You beat him 1v1.
lategame: Bait his revive before you commit.

threats: Cultivation of War (passive) revive at max stacks.
killWindows: When his stacks are low.
